title: DealRecorded v1 (P07 outbox envelope on Kafka)
description: The event P07 commits into event_outbox in the same transaction as the business row, relays to Kafka topic broker.deals.v1, and P08 lands append-only. Delivery is at-least-once: the same event_id may arrive more than once and a consumer must deduplicate. Envelope fields mirror outbox.events.envelope.Envelope; payload fields mirror the DealRecorded FieldSpec list in outbox.events.schema.

decimalString.description: Canonical decimal string. No exponent, no leading '+', no bare '.5' or '5.'. Money never travels as a JSON number.

event_id.description: Stable identity for one business change. A retry reuses it; it is the consumer's deduplication key.

dedupe_key.description: Semantic key. Two events with the same dedupe_key but different payload_sha256 are an integrity incident, not a duplicate.

epoch_id.description: Source incarnation. Events from two epochs are never merged, even when a Deal id repeats.

aggregate_version.description: Per-aggregate ordering guard only. NOT a Deal revision, NOT a global clock, NOT a Kafka offset.

provenance.description: Where this event's facts came from: source cut, scan ids, watermark. Absence is not permission to assume a cut.

realized_pnl_gross.description: Signed. Keeps P03's value; never re-signed downstream.

commission.description: Signed. May legitimately be positive or negative; a consumer must not normalise the sign.

money_currency.description: Absent when the source did not declare one. Never inferred from the symbol.

money_currency_status.description: Explicit statement about whether the currency is known. An unknown currency blocks aggregation; it does not default to USD.

executed_at.description: Source execution time. A new Deal may carry an older executed_at than one already published; event_time ordering is not business ordering.
